items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I believe it was Tyler or Corsicana--but anyway, he was closely in that vicinity of Hot Lips Page, that they had worked together.

ctx.x: Yes. Can you think of anyone else?

I was trying to think. We mentioned Candy Johnson. While we're talking about fine sax men who have been through the band, I mentioned something about Artis Paul. Now Artis Paul was a very fine trumpet man, a tone man, out of Texas and he-- I believe it was Tyler or Corsicana--but anyway, he was closely in that vicinity of Hot Lips Page, that they had worked together. Sometimes you wouldn't get the best of Artis, but I think he got onto whiskey-- he's gone on now like all the rest of us have to do someday--but he…
